description: This file defines an internal interface ICatalog within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. The interface provides a method for deleting activations from a silo, indicating its role in managing grain and activation state in the Orleans distributed virtual actor system.

classes.name: ICatalog
classes.description: An internal interface to manage grain and activation states, specifically providing a method to delete activations from a silo.

methods.name: DeleteActivations
methods.description: Deletes specified activations from the silo, given a list of addresses, a reason code, and a reason text.
